forces: Coverage cannot fail today because Codecov is informational, test runs set no minimum threshold, and coverage is not a required CI check (#271).
Coverage enforcement must be reproducible locally on developer workstations without depending on external cloud services.
Third-party service outages (e.g. Codecov) must not block PR merges or critical path development.
Branch protection required context set and repository documentation must remain synchronized.
A deliberate coverage regression must fail closed and turn the gate red (null control).
